data.exact_reserve_text: The settlement of these claims continues to be managed actively and the number of open claims on this account has reduced from 1,488 at December 2013 to 964 at December 2014. The current net reserve held against IPH is GBP 104.6m (2013: GBP 127.0m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Number of open claims reduced (1,488 -> 964) and net reserve reduced from GBP 127.0m to GBP 104.6m (net release). This is an on-going prior-years medical malpractice exposure affecting 2007 & prior years of account.
The board resolved to close the 2012 year of account at a loss of GBP 6.3m.

named_events.loss_description: Net reserve reduced from GBP 127.0m to GBP 104.6m with number of open claims falling from 1,488 to 964

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 581.108m (balance sheet prior year). The syndicate reports mixed prior-year development: there was a notable net reduction in the reserve held for Italian Public Hospitals (medical malpractice) from GBP 127.0m to GBP 104.6m (net release), while other prior year elements and the closure of the 2012 year of account produced adverse outcomes (2012 closed at a loss of GBP 6.3m). The overall 2014 results were driven by adverse developments in Dutch hospital medical malpractice, an Australian binder in general liability and the sports sector in personal accident, together with reduced reinsurance recoverables.
raw_causal_phrases: deteriorations in Dutch Hospital business in the Medical Malpractice class, Australian Binder in the General Liability class, sports sector in the Personal Accident class and reduction in Medical Malpractice reinsurance recoverables which collectively resulted in additional losses of GBP 27.7m.
The settlement of these claims continues to be managed actively and the number of open claims on this account has reduced from 1,488 at December 2013 to 964 at December 2014.
The current net reserve held against IPH is GBP 104.6m (2013: GBP 127.0m).
The board of MMA resolved to close the 2012 year of account at a loss of GBP 6.3m.
